location.address: 2000 Galloping Hill Road, 11 NEST Building, Kenilworth, NJ 07033
location.site_note: NEST / former Merck campus; Kenilworth records identify Block 181, Lot 1 / Lot 1.0102 and Building K11 / 11 NEST.

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11. Kenilworth Planning Board approved CoreWeave Application #25-003 for the 2000 Galloping Hill Road data center on 2025-05-15 and approved the written resolution on 2025-05-27; NJEDA's 2025-11-12 board book states CoreWeave confirmed construction began on 2025-09-15. No public energization, certificate of occupancy, partial-live, or full-buildout record was located.
evidence_grade: A- for local planning approval and NJEDA construction-start/incentive evidence; B for current capacity because CoreWeave company disclosure says up to 250 MW while NJEDA board materials and local records do not publish a final energized MW figure.

actions.result_status: CoreWeave signed a long-term lease for all of Building 11 NEST at the Northeast Science & Technology Center and announced plans to convert the roughly 280,000-square-foot former lab/manufacturing building into a data center, with CoreWeave planning to invest $1.2 billion and the Onyx-led venture expecting to spend more than $50 million.
actions.access_caveat: Company/developer announcement; not a local approval, building permit, or energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Use for announcement, initial lease structure, project sponsor, and initial investment/square-footage context.

actions.result_status: Planning Board minutes state Application #25-004 for Kenilworth Corporate Property Urban Renewal LLC proposed a substation at 2000 Galloping Hill Road to serve a future data center; the board approved the application.
actions.vote_tally: Picerno, David, Pantina, Laudati, Mazzeo, Scuderi, Deluca, Grimaldi and Pugliese voted yes
actions.access_caveat: Official local-government minutes; confirms local substation approval context, not data-center energization.
actions.evidence_note: Supports utility-infrastructure/local-process context for the data-center project.

actions.result_status: Planning Board minutes state CoreWeave Application #25-003 proposed converting the NEST 11 laboratory building into a data center at 2000 Galloping Hill Road, including 31 generators, a chiller yard with 29 chiller units and 4 water tanks, security fencing, parking and infiltration improvements; the board approved the application.
actions.vote_tally: Picerno, David, Scorese, Clementi, Laudati, Scuderi, Grimaldi and Pugliese voted yes
actions.access_caveat: Official local-government minutes; browser text has minor OCR inconsistencies, but the approval and project facts are readable.
actions.evidence_note: Primary local approval evidence for the Building 11 data-center conversion.

actions.result_status: Planning Board minutes state the board heard and approved the CoreWeave Data Center application on 2025-05-15, including testimony regarding Building K11 and two minor dimensional variances, then approved the resolution for CoreWeave at 2000 Galloping Hill Road.
actions.vote_tally: Picerno, Scorese, Clementi, Laudati, Scuderi, Grimaldi and Pugliese voted yes

actions.result_status: CoreWeave reported it was developing, as part of a joint venture, a new data center campus in Kenilworth, NJ, with capacity of up to 250 MW and initial phase expected to be delivered in 2026.
actions.access_caveat: Company investor release; capacity and delivery timing are forward-looking and not proof of energized load.
actions.evidence_note: Best current company-published MW capacity located in this refresh.

actions.government_body: Borough of Kenilworth Mayor and Council
actions.result_status: Council minutes show Resolution No. 25-231 repealed and replaced Resolution No. 25-129 and conditionally designated CW Grosbeaks Nest Urban Renewal LLC as redeveloper of Block 181, Lot 1.0102 in the 2000 Galloping Hill Road Redevelopment Plan area, subject to an acceptable redevelopment agreement within 120 days, extendable by 60 days. The recitals describe a rehabilitated lab/manufacturing building and approximately 550,000 square-foot data center(s) with roadway and infrastructure improvements.
actions.access_caveat: Official local-government minutes; confirms conditional redeveloper designation and redevelopment-plan context, not final redevelopment agreement execution.
actions.evidence_note: Supports owner/redeveloper entity and larger redevelopment-project context.

actions.action_type: Next NJ Program - AI tax credit award approval
actions.result_status: NJEDA board book requested approval of a $50 million per year, five-year, $250 million total Next NJ Program - AI tax credit award to CoreWeave for the 2000 Galloping Hill Road, 11 NEST Building project. NJEDA records list the application date as 2025-07-31, 143 new jobs, approximately $1.758 billion capital investment, a $25 million collaboration commitment, and CoreWeave confirmation that construction began on 2025-09-15.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: CoreWeave, Inc., Next NJ Program - AI Application
actions.access_caveat: Official NJEDA board-book PDF; board-book request/approval materials are public, but no utility energization or certificate of occupancy is included.
actions.evidence_note: Primary state economic-development evidence for construction-start date, investment, jobs, project location, and tax-credit award.

actions.result_status: Union County's 2025 Land Development Summary Report lists Core Weave, Inc. at 2000 Galloping Hill Rd., Kenilworth, as a Data Center project with 247,000 square feet and no residential units.
actions.access_caveat: Official county summary report; project table does not provide MW capacity, permit number, or construction/energization status.
actions.evidence_note: County-level confirmation of data-center land-development listing.

actions.result_status: NEST's campus page lists Building 11 NEST as occupied by CoreWeave and describes CoreWeave's large-scale, energy-efficient server farms for AI, machine-learning, visual-effects rendering, and blockchain processing workloads.
actions.access_caveat: Property/developer marketing page; not a public permit, construction-start, or energization record.

capacity_note: CoreWeave's 2025-08-12 investor release describes the Kenilworth campus as having capacity of up to 250 MW. Treat as planned/contracted maximum capacity, not verified energized load. Union County and Kenilworth local records found in this refresh report square footage but not MW.
owner: CoreWeave / CW Grosbeaks Nest Urban Renewal LLC as redeveloper and project entity; CoreWeave initially announced a lease for Building 11 NEST in 2024, and Kenilworth Council minutes on 2025-10-15 state CoreWeave acquired approximately 40 acres of the former Merck site. Public deed-level ownership was not independently verified in this refresh.

contradictions.details: Official/local records use several scopes: Kenilworth Planning Board and Union County list about 247,000 square feet for the Building 11 conversion; CoreWeave/Onyx's 2024 announcement describes roughly 280,000 square feet; Kenilworth Council redevelopment recitals describe approximately 550,000 square-foot data center(s); RE-NJ, citing EDA, reports 392,600 square feet including 108,100 square feet of new construction and a 284,500-square-foot retrofit. Treat 247,000 as the approved existing-building/site-plan figure and 392,600/550,000 as broader expansion/redevelopment scopes until primary plans are reconciled.

CoreWeave's 2025-08-12 investor release says the initial phase is expected in 2026, while RE-NJ, citing EDA, reports the AI data center is expected to be operational in early 2027. No official certificate of occupancy, energization, or commissioning record was found.

CoreWeave 2025-08-12 investor release states the Kenilworth campus has capacity of up to 250 MW; not verified as energized load.
